title: Question 29
passage:
The Japanese and Korean groups start at the same time, and the tour app plays only one language at a time.
A. Both recordings are already in the app. B. Let's use the app for one group and give the other a live interpreter. C. We can switch the app to Korean after the Japanese recording ends.
passageZh:
日語團和韓語團同時出發，但導覽 App 一次只能播一種語言。
A. 兩種語言的錄音都已經放進 App 了。
B. 一團用 App，另一團就安排現場口譯員。
C. 我們可以等日語錄音播完，再把 App 切換成韓語。
